bundle.shortDescription: Preview the all-safe cleanup, then run it.
bundle.longDescription: linux-cleanup runs a dry run of its all-safe cleanup first, shows the cache paths it would remove and the ones it keeps, and writes a local report of every real run. Removal is permanent.
